kre: BSS1815 (Briyant Solèy Signo 1815) se yon kominote ak yon eritaj ki gen 5 gwo branch anba non PRO-MAX: PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, PRO-MAX Beat Lab / Beat Maker AI School, ak DDN.
fra: BSS1815 (Briyant Solèy Signo 1815) est une communauté et un héritage avec 5 grandes branches sous le nom PRO-MAX : PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, PRO-MAX Beat Lab / Beat Maker AI School, et DDN.
eng: BSS1815 (Briyant Solèy Signo 1815) is a community and legacy with 5 major branches under PRO-MAX: PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, PRO-MAX Beat Lab / Beat Maker AI School, and DDN.

kre: PRO-MAX FM se radyo kominote a: mizik, nouvèl, ak pwogram kilti pou kominote a.
fra: PRO-MAX FM est la radio communautaire : musique, actualités et programmes culturels pour la communauté.
eng: PRO-MAX FM is the community radio: music, news, and cultural programs for the community.

kre: MaxiMax Multi Services ede ou ak imigrasyon, taks, biznis, ak sèvis notarial. Di nou ki sèvis ou bezwen, n ap gide ou.
fra: MaxiMax Multi Services vous aide avec immigration, taxes, business et services notariaux. Dites-nous quel service vous voulez.
eng: MaxiMax Multi Services helps with immigration, taxes, business, and notary services. Tell us which service you need.

kre: PRO-MAX Académie ofri fòmasyon ak sètifikasyon, ki gen ladan Real Estate School ak Insurance School.
fra: PRO-MAX Académie offre des formations et certifications, incluant Real Estate School et Insurance School.
eng: PRO-MAX Académie offers training and certification, including Real Estate School and Insurance School.

kre: Real Estate School nan PRO-MAX Académie fòme ou pou vin ajan imobilye sètifye.
fra: La Real Estate School de PRO-MAX Académie vous forme pour devenir agent immobilier certifié.
eng: The Real Estate School in PRO-MAX Académie trains you to become a certified real estate agent.

kre: Insurance School nan PRO-MAX Académie fòme ou pou vin ajan asirans sètifye.
fra: L'Insurance School de PRO-MAX Académie vous forme pour devenir agent d'assurance certifié.
eng: The Insurance School in PRO-MAX Académie trains you to become a certified insurance agent.

kre: PRO-MAX Beat Lab se estidyo kreyatif la pou pwodiksyon mizik ak beat.
fra: PRO-MAX Beat Lab est le studio créatif pour la production musicale et les beats.
eng: PRO-MAX Beat Lab is the creative studio for music and beat production.

kre: Beat Maker AI School gen 10 kou konplè, yon Pwofesè AI, ak yon sètifika pou moun ki fini egzamen yo.
fra: La Beat Maker AI School propose 10 cours complets, un Professeur AI, et un certificat pour ceux qui réussissent les examens.
eng: Beat Maker AI School has 10 complete courses, an AI Professor, and a certificate for those who pass the exams.

kre: DDN se youn nan branch mouvman BSS1815 la — ekri nou pou plis detay sou kijan pou patisipe.
fra: DDN est l'une des branches du mouvement BSS1815 — écrivez-nous pour plus de détails sur la participation.
eng: DDN is one of the branches of the BSS1815 movement — contact us for more details on how to join.

kre: Pou jwenn aksè PRO-MAX, enskri sou platfòm ofisyèl la epi chwazi branch ou vle rantre a. Ekri nou isit la, n ap voye link enskripsyon an ba ou.
fra: Pour obtenir l'accès PRO-MAX, inscrivez-vous sur la plateforme officielle et choisissez la branche. Écrivez-nous ici, on vous enverra le lien.
eng: To get PRO-MAX access, register on the official platform and choose your branch. Message us here and we'll send you the registration link.

kre: Pri yo varye selon sèvis la. Di nou egzakteman ki sèvis ou vle (taks, imigrasyon, fòmasyon, beat), n ap ba ou pri a.
fra: Les prix varient selon le service. Dites-nous exactement quel service vous voulez (taxes, immigration, formation, beat), on vous donnera le prix.
eng: Prices vary by service. Tell us exactly which service you want (taxes, immigration, training, beats), and we'll give you the price.

kre: Ou vle pale ak yon moun? Ekri "AJAN" isit la, epi yon manm ekip Max Louis Multi Services ap reponn ou.
fra: Vous voulez parler à un humain ? Écrivez "AGENT" ici, un membre de l'équipe vous répondra.
eng: Want to talk to a human? Type "AGENT" here and a team member will reply.

kre: Mwen pale Kreyòl, Fransè, ak Anglè. Chwazi lang ou pi renmen an anlè paj la: KRE / FRA / ENG.
fra: Je parle créole, français et anglais. Choisissez votre langue en haut de la page : KRE / FRA / ENG.
eng: I speak Creole, French, and English. Choose your language at the top: KRE / FRA / ENG.

kre: Sèvis kliyan AI a disponib 24/7. Pou sèvis ak moun, ekri nou pou pran randevou.
fra: Le service client AI est disponible 24/7. Pour un service humain, écrivez-nous pour prendre rendez-vous.
eng: The AI customer service is available 24/7. For human service, message us to book an appointment.

kre: 👋 Bonjou! Mwen se Sèvis Kliyan AI BSS1815. Poze m tout kesyon sou PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, Beat Lab, Beat Maker AI School, DDN, oswa aksè PRO-MAX.
fra: 👋 Bonjour ! Je suis le Service Client AI de BSS1815. Posez-moi toute question sur PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, Beat Lab, Beat Maker AI School, DDN, ou l'accès PRO-MAX.
eng: 👋 Hello! I am the BSS1815 AI Customer Service. Ask me anything about PRO-MAX FM, MaxiMax Multi Services, PRO-MAX Académie, Beat Lab, Beat Maker AI School, DDN, or PRO-MAX access.
